text:
elaine.jenkins: Quick heads-up — we’re shipping the customer handshake and PS checklist for on-prem deployments this week. Targeting immediate communication to GA customers and the PS team.

samir.khan: Thanks — can you paste the checklist link? want to sync with sales docs.

elaine.jenkins: sure: https://internal.redwood/handshake/onprem-ps-checklist (internal)
- Key sections: pre-engagement security questionnaire, network prep, KMS/HSM onboarding, airgap steps, telemetry opt-in guidance, escalation contacts.

ps-onboarding-bot: *New checklist published* by elaine.jenkins — /handshake/onprem-ps-checklist — reviewers: @kayla.ops @ctojordan :memo:

kayla.ops: I skimmed — we should add an explicit step for customer side NTP/time sync and BIOS firmware baseline. saw a customer outage last month caused by skew.

elaine.jenkins: good call. adding NTP step in the infra prep section. will update the doc and post v1.1.

ctojordan: Also add a note about fallback routing: when onprem nodes report degraded GPU telemetry, PS should enable model-variant fallback for the customer before engaging infra. saves a lot of triage time.

samir.khan: FYI for sales: this checklist will be the source of truth for kickoff calls. Can we export a short "one-pager" for AE use?

elaine.jenkins: yes — working with docs to produce a 1-page kickoff summary and an editable slide deck for AEs. ETA EOD Friday.

kayla.ops: Ops action items (from checklist):
• Create customer-specific runbook template (template id RB-ONP-01)
• Pre-provision temporary BMC access window protocol
• Validate KMS attestation flow with customer KMS vendor (HSM partners list attached)

elaine.jenkins: Added contact list: @platform-kms, @security-eng, and partner contacts. Also flagged the compliance appendix for customers wanting FedRAMP/FIPS guidance.

ps-onboarding-bot: Reminder scheduled: "PS checklist review" on 1800000200 for @kayla.ops, @samir.khan.

samir.khan: Any changes to billing or SOW templates tied to on-prem installs? need legal loop.

elaine.jenkins: We made two small SOW additions: explicit maintenance windows and telemetry opt-in line-item. Legal already reviewed and greenlit — see clause refs SOW-ONP-3a/b in the doc.

ctojordan: Please ensure the rollout messaging to customers emphasizes the optional telemetry and how to opt out. avoid surprises.

elaine.jenkins: agreed. will include a short script for AEs: "Telemetry is optional; we recommend it for performance insights but it can be disabled — here are the steps."

kayla.ops: Ops note: after the first five customer installs, we’ll run a post-install retrospective to capture gaps. proposed date window: 2 weeks after each install.

samir.khan: tagging @customer-success to schedule onboarding slots after PS confirms readiness.

ps-onboarding-bot: Checklist v1.0 published by elaine.jenkins at 1799999999. v1.1 planned for 1800000000 with NTP + one-pager deliverable.

elaine.jenkins: Closing notes: please review the checklist before the scheduled review at 1800000200. If you have objections to the PS play items, reply here or mark comments in the doc. :rotating_light: This is customer-facing content so keep feedback focused and actionable.

kayla.ops: Reviewed. no blockers from infra side. :thumbsup:

samir.khan: Reviewed for GTM — will prep AE slide and notify the sales mailing list once one-pager is ready.

ctojordan: Approved from engineering. thanks team.

ps-onboarding-bot: Reminder: "PS checklist review" triggered at 1800000200 — attendees: kayla.ops, samir.khan.
